{{Quote|I was a good servant to the Empire. My own people rose in rebellion. They sent my command out to Hunt them down. And I did it, Fett. I Hunted them across the northlands, and I caught them in the city of Montellian Serat. We shelled them until they surrendered.''"<br />"''And after taking their surrender, you executed them. Seven hundred of them.|[[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]|<ref name="TLOS:TToBF" />}}
The '''Battle of Montellian Serat''' was a battle fought at the city of [[Montellian Serat/Legends|Montellian Serat]], on [[Devaron/Legends|Devaron]]. [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] supporters of the anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] uprising were hunted by the [[Devaronian Army]], led by [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]], in the northlands of the planet. They were eventually besieged in the city of Montellian Serat and bombarded until they surrendered. After the battle, the Devaronian Army was ordered to reinforce Imperial troops in another battle but the Devaronians were unable to take care of any prisoners.<ref name="TLOS:TToBF" /> Kardue'sai'Malloc eventually gave the order to execute the seven hundred captured Rebel supporters,<ref name="EB:TDT" /><ref name="TLOS:TToBF" /> including men, women, and children.<ref name="TEGtC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> The city of Montellian Serat was also destroyed to prevent any other city to shelter Rebels. It took almost six months for the Rebellion on Devaron to be put down.<ref name="EB:TDT" /> The slaughter of Montellian Serat gave Kardue'sai'Malloc the nickname "Butcher of Montellian Serat".<ref name="EB:TDT" /><ref name="TLOS:TToBF" /><ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|198|Kardue'sai'Malloc}}</ref>
